lines: After a fierce battle, Asagi-san's special attack tore the body of the divine beast to pieces.
The giant boar howled in misery.
Its mountain-like body collapsed to the ground with an earth-shaking sound.
He was pretty tough... His behavior was a bit iffy though.
Right. One wrong move and we could've been done for. But yeah, his behavior was iffy...
Asagi-san and I lowered our weapons and caught our breaths.
Kiyomaro had been extraordinarily powerful, as one would expect from a divine giant boar.
Not deterred by the cramped confines within the building that put him at a disadvantage, the giant boar had charged at us,
and Asagi-san had withstood the powerful attack with my support, found a slight opening, and unleashed her ultimate attackー
It had been a narrow victory.
Guhhh... To think I would be defeated... But this, too, is my fate.
Tell me your wish, human. I will use the power of the luck slumbering within me to grant it...
The fallen Kiyomaro said, gasping for breath with each word.
So... Asagi-san, may I use my wish?
As I asked, Asagi-san smiled as if to say "of course."
Yes. The only thing the old lady at Inageya asked of me was to stop this boar from turning into an inauspicious beast.
You can use his luck as you please. ...But, I imagine the way you'll use it is already settled.
My wish, of course, was to "return to my dimension"ー
Can you do that, Kiyomaro? I want to go back to my world.
The dying Kiyomaro nodded and released the luck that lay dormant within his giant body.
Accompanied by a mysterious bellowing sound that shook the air, a massive energy vortex appeared.
...Now then, I've opened a portal. You should be able to return to your dimension by jumping in here...
Alright. Thanks, Kiyomaro... Though it's weird to be thanking you.
You're the one who dragged me here in the first place.
Never mind that. In the end, you are able to go home.
I don't want to hear it from you.
And stop changing up your tone on a whim too.
Ahem. Well then... I will fade away now.
I have used up all of my power. The next time I appear will be 12 years from now...
I asked Kiyomaro, whose body was starting to disappear.
(If I really think about it, I feel pity for him...)
He was summoned here and chased around because of the power of his luck.
He might have acted a little weird, but maybe I should forgive him.
No... I'll simply disappear, in accordance with my fate. ...But if there's one thing I regret...
Just like you humans... I wanted to get engaged to an actress and fly to the moon and things like that... blargh.
Leaving behind those lonesome words, the body of Kiyomaro, the divine giant boar, vanished.
...He was quite the troubled individual, huh.
Asagi-san and I sighed, our mixed feelings again showing on our faces.
We felt like we had spent the whole day getting pushed around by the strangest people.
Anyway... Thanks, Asagi-san. I owe you a bunch for today.
Eheh, don't worry about it. I just did what I had to do.
But good for you. You're able to go back to your world.
Surely this was farewell. Asagi-san held out her hand and I grabbed it tightly.
It kind of feels like a shame. Just getting to know each other and already having to say goodbye.
This young Asagi-san literally lived in a different world.
If we parted ways now, most likely we would never see each other again.
You never know. Recently, demons and other beings with weird powers are showing up more oftenー
You might come here or I might go to there. Something like that could happen again.
Asagi-san's comment made me remember something.
So much has been going on that I didn't get a chance, but... There's something I've been meaning to ask you, Asagi-san.
Just then, my consciousness suddenly started to drift away. It felt as if something was sucking me up off the ground.
I tried to ask Asagi-san about her younger sister, Sakura, but my consciousness was completely absorbed into the darkness.
Hey, Fuma-kun! How long are you going to keep sleeping~?
Oh!! You're finally up~! Really, what were you thinking?
Talking about how much you wanted to see the first sunrise together and then falling asleep by yourself!
I was in the freeloader Sakura's room, back at the ever-familiar Fuma residence.
Right in front of me was a game console that had been left on.
Snacks and magazines were scattered all over the floor.
Everything was the same as before I had left.
I let out a sigh of relief.
Well, until a minute ago, I was a giant boar in another dimension and everyone was chasing me.
You had one hell of a first dream of the year, huh, Fuma-kun?
It was... all a dream. Probably.
That was easier to come to grips with than going to another dimension in your sleep.
Come on, go and wash your face. I made some New Year's ozoni with Tokiko-san, so let's all eat together!
I stopped Sakura as she was about to return to the living room.
It's nothing important, but... are you having fun?
Huh~~~~~~? What are you talking about all of a sudden?
I-I mean, you were brought here from another dimension. I was just wondering if something was troubling youー
Not at all! Of course I'm having fun!
Yeah♪ I mean, it was a little troubling at first~
But now I'm having so much fun being together with Tokiko-san and you, Fuma-kun!
I see... "She" seemed to be doing fine too, so I guess it proves that you're sisters.
Hearing me mutter, Sakura tilted her head curiously.
...Yeah, I was just thinking about the dream I had last night.
Yeah, yeah. Get out of dreamland and go and wash your face already!
Alright then, I'm gonna ask Tokiko-san to put lots of lily bulbs in the New Year's ozoni for me♪
Sakura grinned happily and returned to the living room.
Hey, wait! I'm gonna get more lily bulbs than you!
